1. (Currently amended) A method for controlling a vehicle, the method comprising:
determining that whether one or more surrounding vehicles demonstrates demonstrate threatening behavior by detecting that a first surrounding vehicle directly in front of the vehicle slows down in an absence of a traffic related reason to slow down and a person approaches the vehicle; and
upon determining when it is determined that the one or more surrounding vehicles demonstrates demonstrate threatening behavior, controlling the vehicle to perform one or more threat evasive actions.
2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein determining that the whether one or more surrounding vehicles demonstrates demonstrate threatening behavior is based on:
information regarding surrounding vehicles acquired by one or more external sensors mounted on the vehicle; and
interpretation of the information regarding surrounding vehicles to provide one or more threat determining metrics metric associated with the one or more surrounding vehicles.
3. (Currently amended) The method of claim 2, wherein the one or more threat determiningmetrics associated with the one or more surrounding vehicles metric associated with a surrounding vehicle comprise one or more of a speed of the one or more surrounding vehicles, surrounding vehicle, a velocity of the one or more surrounding vehicles, surrounding vehicle, a difference between speed of the one or more surrounding vehicles surrounding vehicle and a speed of the controlled vehicle, a difference between velocity of the one or more surrounding vehicles surrounding vehicle and a velocity of the controlled vehicle, a distance between the one or more surrounding vehicles surrounding vehicle and the controlled vehicle,or and a trend of the distance between the one or more surrounding vehicles surrounding vehicle and the controlled vehicle.
4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein determining that one or more surrounding vehicles demonstrates demonstrating threatening behavior further comprises detecting that a second first surrounding vehicle blocks a route of the vehicle alternative to forward progressiondirectly in front of the vehicle slowing down in absence of traffic related reason to slow down.
5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 4, wherein one or more surrounding vehicles demonstrating threatening behavior further comprises a the second surrounding vehicle that blocks the route of the vehicle alternative to forward progression is in an adjacent lane to the vehicle and slows slowing down in association with the first surrounding vehicle.
6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein controlling the vehicle to perform one or more threat evasive actions comprises controlling the vehicle to perform one or more of:
activating a visual deterrent maneuver;
activating an audial deterrent maneuver;
activating an intrusion mitigating maneuver;
disabling a collision avoidance system;
taking an available escape route;
initiating an emergency call;or and initiating a call to a remote controller.
7. (Original) A non-transitory computer readable medium storing a computer program comprising program instructions, the computer program being loadable into a data processing unit and configured to cause execution of the method according to claim 1 when the computer program is run by the data processing unit.
8. (Original) A control unit for controlling a vehicle, the control unit being configured to cause execution of the method according to claim 1.
9. (Currently amended) An apparatus for controlling a vehicle, the apparatus comprising controlling circuitry configured to cause:
determination that of whether one or more surrounding vehicles demonstrates demonstrate threatening behavior by detecting that a first surrounding vehicle directly in front of the vehicle slows down in an absence of a traffic related reason to slow down and a person approaches the vehicle; and
responsive to the determination that the one or more surrounding vehicles demonstrates demonstrate threatening behavior, control of the vehicle to perform one or more threat evasive actions.
10. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 9, wherein the controlling circuitry is further configured to cause:
acquisition of information regarding surrounding vehicles from one or more external sensors mounted on the vehicle; and
interpretation of the information regarding surrounding vehicles to provide one or more threat determining metrics metric associated with the one or more surrounding vehicles, wherein determination of whether one or more surrounding vehicles demonstrate threatening behavior is based on the one or more threat determining metricsmetric.

12. A system for controlling a vehicle, the system comprising:
one or more external sensors mountable on the vehicle and configured to acquire information regarding one or more surrounding vehicles; and
the apparatus of claim 9, wherein the determination is made based on the controlling circuitry interpreting processing circuitry configured to: interpret the information regarding surrounding vehicles to provide one or more threat determining metric associated with the one or more surrounding vehicles;
